questions.text: Why does processOrder execute paymentService.charge before updating the order status to PROCESSED and saving to orderRepository?
In processOrder, what happens if the fetched order is null? How does the exception prevent further processing?
Explain how checkout in OrderController delegates to processOrder and handles the returned Order entity.

keyPoints: Ensures payment is successfully charged before recording order as PROCESSED
Prevents marking unpaid orders as processed in case charge throws an exception
answerKeys.rationale: Evaluates understanding of transaction boundaries and payment failure ordering

keyPoints: Checks null explicitly and throws OrderNotFoundException
Halts execution so paymentService.charge is never invoked for invalid orders
answerKeys.rationale: Verifies guard clause and null safety comprehension

keyPoints: OrderController.checkout receives orderId and calls orderService.processOrder
Wraps the processed Order in ResponseEntity.ok
answerKeys.rationale: Verifies understanding of caller-callee relationship across controller and service layers
